residualBoundary.normal: No >33 ms frames in either C2 4X warmed phase. Fresh/re-entry phases retain isolated 100-309 ms events, including submission stalls around ticks 520 and 587-591.
residualBoundary.user: Residual random skips primarily while scrolling; no other anomalies observed in the tested session.
residualBoundary.confirmed: Normal raw rows localize the later long frames to render submission rather than simulation/update.

residualBoundary.nextCapture: Existing C2 Small 4X Normal; press F9 once about five seconds after the live match appears. This captures the observed 8-9 second events. Preserve the current A/B timings separately.
